rows.abstract: Sets up a system that will strictly enforce the anti-smuggling law by amending certain sections in the Tariff and Customs Code of the Philippines (TCCP), as amended. Is based on the observation that smuggling and other farudulent importations remainunchecked because the old provisions of the TCCP contain loopholes that the smugglers take advantage of as their way out of prosecutions.

Increases the penalties for the violation of certain provisions of TCCP in order to deter vioaltors including the officials, agents or employees of the BOC or of any agency of the government charged with enforcement of the provisions of thisAct.
